sections.Profile:
"Guys Dolls," produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1953, is a unique woodrail pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
